content.text: My Favourites (0) AddGet BeinlanguageENESEditionUnited StatesbeIN XTRAManage NotificationsContact UsTV GuideHome > Soccer > Friendlies > Live Blog: Spain vs Egypt LIVE score and updates from international friendlyLive Blog: Spain vs Egypt LIVE score and updates from international friendly03/31/2026 - 05:57 PM - by Miguel CalixtoThe Spain national team, led by Luis de la Fuente, plays its final preparation match before the summer and ahead of the 2026 World Cup squad announcement.The match ends in Spain Spain and the Pharaohs failed to score and the game ended goalless Egypt's red card 84' Hamdy Fathy receives a red card and the Pharaohs finish with ten men Fermín López missed a golden opportunity The Barcelona player couldn't finish and the ball went just wide of the post. Spain and Egypt play to a goalless draw La Roja dominated from the start, but the Pharaohs leveled the score and even created some dangerous chances. Dani Olmo is the most active in attack Despite the efforts, we remain 0-0 against Egypt The match is being played in Spain La Roja faces EgyptThe Spain national team, led by Luis de la Fuente, plays its final preparation match before the summer and ahead of the 2026 World Cup squad announcement.They face Egypt, a strong opponent coming into this friendly. How Spain and Egypt arrive Spain come into the match after a convincing 3-0 win over Serbia and boast an impressive run of 31 wins in 38 matches under Luis de la Fuente.Egypt, meanwhile, secured a 4-0 victory over Saudi Arabia but arrive after a long seven-hour trip.
